Cover has its work ahead of it trying to take on the California housing market. Bu
viral_opportunities.author: @ashleevance
viral_opportunities.summary: Journalist Ashlee Vance notes Palisades rebuilding has stalled 18 months post-fire due to insurance, regulation, and labor shortages.
viral_opportunities.engagement_angle: Palisades rebuild-frustration story without a design/luxury hook—capped per policy; watch for insurance-reform specifics to develop.

viral_reply.body: The speed story is real, but the underwriting story matters as much — non-combustible assemblies and WPH Plus detailing are what move insurability in the Palisades rebuild math.

viral_reply.body: Coverage decisions increasingly follow the structure itself — non-combustible construction and Zone 0 clearance are two of the few levers a homeowner actually controls in underwriting.

viral_opportunities.author: @BridgetAyers
viral_opportunities.summary: Tweet debating whether Jonathan Scott's RSG 3-D non-combustible building system truly resists wildfire.
viral_opportunities.engagement_angle: Track this thread—could be a chance to contrast proprietary panel systems with reinforced-concrete performance claims.

viral_reply.body: Good nuance. Non-combustible ≠ indestructible, but sustained-heat performance of shotcrete over EPS is genuinely different from framing — and it's the assembly detailing that decides the outcome.
